= Typography across attribute fragments
:tail: s
:join: --
:dots: ..
:close: )
:empty:

pass:a,r[(C{close}] and pass:a,r[.{dots}] and pass:a,r[left{join}right].

pass:r,a[(C{close}] and pass:r,a[.{dots}] and pass:r,a[left{join}right].

pass:a,r[Sam'{tail}] and pass:r,a[Sam'{tail}].

pass:a,r[Sam'{empty}s] and pass:r,a[Sam'{empty}s].

pass:a,r[Sam{empty}'s] and pass:r,a[Sam{empty}'s].

pass:a,r[left{empty}--right] and pass:r,a[left{empty}--right].

pass:a,r[left--{empty}right] and pass:r,a[left--{empty}right].

pass:a,r[(C{empty})] and pass:r,a[(C{empty})].

pass:a,r[\(C{close}] and pass:a,r[\.{dots}].

pass:q,r[*left*--right] and pass:r,q[left--*right*].

pass:a,r[{backslash}(C)] and pass:r,a[{backslash}(C)].
